units: metres (1 BU = 1 m); FBX exported with FBX_SCALE_UNITS so Unreal sees centimetres
axes: Z up, bow toward -Y in Blender; FBX axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y (Blender defaults)
waterline: Z = 0 is the sea surface; hulls continue below it (draft_m)
lods: LOD0..LOD3 as children of a LodGroup node in each FBX; screen sizes 1.0 / 0.35 / 0.12 / 0.04

material_contract.textures: T_Ship_<Sheet>_D (sRGB), _N (OpenGL normal, flip green in UE), _ORM (AO, roughness, metallic), _M (linear)
material_contract.mask_channels: M.R night-window emissive, M.G culture-tint mask, M.B always-on emissive (engine glow, uses D as colour)
material_contract.uv: trim sheets: V stays inside one band per face; U tiles (texture Wrap on U)
